subject: NovusBio: temporary hybrid-SKU bridge & reservation hold request
messages:
From: Emma Reed <emma@novusbio.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short-term H100 access + reservation hold for migration

Hi Tessa,

Quick context: we have a three-week migration window starting Nov 29 where a subset of inference traffic (approx 18% peak, sustained 12% baseline) needs to run on H100-class instances to validate our new quantized weights for latency-sensitive endpoints. Our existing Dedicated commitment is for A100 family and we cannot convert that reservation immediately.

Ask: can Redwood approve a time‑boxed "hybrid-SKU bridge" allowing NovusBio to run on H100 for the migration window (6 weeks total including validation), with:
- a reservation hold (prevent auto-cancellation) on our existing A100 pool
- ability to burst onto H100 with an agreed overage rate or credit mechanism
- a short discount on incremental burst units to offset migration cost (we were thinking 15% as a compromise)

We need contract-level clarity (pricing, cap, and rollback) before the migration kick-off. Attaching a short migration plan and usage forecast. Can you route this to deal desk / execs for a one-off exception?

Thanks,
Emma Reed
Head of Infrastructure, NovusBio
Attachments: Novus_Migration_Forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Looping you both — NovusBio (deal NB-2027-114) wants a 6-week H100 bridge while their team validates new weights. Key items from the customer: reservation hold on existing A100 commitment (don’t let it auto-cancel), H100 burst access, and a modest discount on burst units. They propose 15% off burst pricing.

I attached their MAP and forecast here (see attachment). Proposed commercial approach from AE perspective:
- Approve a time-limited SKU bridge for 6 weeks
- Set overage pricing at 1.35x of A100 baseline rate (to reflect H100 premium), with a capped monthly spend at 150% of committed dollars
- Offer a 20% burst discount on incremental tokens up to 2x committed throughput for the window
- Require DocuSign amendment and finance sign-off; legal to confirm reservation hold language

Requesting deal desk + exec approval on the above. If we can get an approval today we can ship the amendment and get signature before their Nov 29 window. Attach: novusbio-sku-bridge-term-sheet-v1.xlsx, Novus_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf

Thanks — Tessa

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short-term H100 access + reservation hold for migration

Tessa — thanks for the summary and the draft TS. I support a controlled exception with the following guardrails:

1) Term: 6 weeks (start date to be specified in amendment). No auto-extensions.
2) Reservation hold: we will flag the A100 reservation to prevent termination for the window; legal to add explicit "reservation hold" clause.
3) H100 overage pricing: set at 1.35x the published A100 baseline rate for identical unit types.
4) Burst discount: 20% off the overage unit price for incremental usage up to 2x committed throughput. Any usage beyond that reverts to 1.35x with no discount.
5) Spend cap: monthly customer liability capped at 150% of committed dollars; Redwood to notify at 80% threshold and require written acknowledgement to exceed cap.
6) Finance treatment: any one-time credits or bill smoothing requires finance approval; propose we limit one-time credit exposure to $60k USD for the term without exec sign-off.
7) DocuSign and signature: terms effective only after signed amendment and payment terms confirmed.

I will attach a revised term sheet and mark the section that requires legal to author the reservation-hold wording (novusbio-sku-bridge-term-sheet-v2.xlsx). If finance needs more runway on the credit cap, we can escalate to Aditya for exec approval.

Lauren
--
Lauren Bishop
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: RE: NovusBio: temporary hybrid-SKU bridge & reservation hold request

Thanks Lauren — I agree with the proposed guardrails and will approve an exception on the following adjusted commercial items:

- Approve 6-week H100 bridge and reservation hold.
- Approve overage pricing at 1.35x A100 baseline.
- Approve a one-time burst discount of 25% off the overage price (instead of 20%) for incremental usage up to 2x committed throughput, to help close the deal.
- Finance cap for one-time credit exposure raised to $80k for this amendment only. Anything beyond requires CFO or VP Finance sign-off.

Conditions: amendment must be signed via DocuSign prior to start date; legal to add the exact reservation-hold language; billing must include a named point-of-contact at Novus for overage notices.

Please prepare the amended term sheet and send to Emma and Daniel with the DocuSign link. Tessa — you can confirm the start date window with the customer once signed.

-Aditya
